title: The family who stopped

greeting.text: The bell. The child you gave the hot chocolate to, holding the hand of a woman in a good coat. They have the same eyes. Not similar. The same.
We wanted to say thank you. You were kind to our youngest. So few people stop.

annoyed: Are you nearly finished looking at us?

notes.wrist: She lays her hands on the counter the way the child did. Palms up. Like a teacher's pet.
notes.reflection: Two backs in the mirror. Watch them sway. Watch which sways first.
notes.shadow: Two pairs of shoes. Count what lies around them.

topics.ask: Where's the rest of the family?
topics.answer: In the car. All of us are in the car. There's ever such a lot of room in the car now.

topics.ask: Your youngest. How many are there?
You're wearing the people who picked it up.
topics.answer: They were so pleased to help. You know how that feels. You gave it the cup.

wren.arrive: Oh, it found a family. Look, Sam. Look what your hot chocolate did.
wren.adviceLine: They only came to say thank you. That's manners. You started this one, Sam. See it through.

after.serve: A whole family. Because of you. You should be proud, really.
after.turnAway: They'll forgive you. They're very forgiving, once there's enough of them.
after.break: That was a family, Sam. You made it and then you unmade it.

serve.text: They go out hand in hand. Neither of them uses the door.

turnAway.text: The same sentence. The same face saying it. Two of them now.

shelter.text: Out the back. Both of you.
Is that where you keep yours? We'd love to see.

break.text: You get it. You helped. That's all we wanted to say.
They leave, and the bell does not ring, and out in the car park a great many car doors close at once.
